n_flagged_definition: Successful-export sentinel always zero, not an independent positive QA measure. Household inconsistencies abort export; missing v9 separately counted.

dwelling_diagnostic.unit: sampled dwelling, unweighted diagnostic; never official dwelling estimator

r_extraction.coercion_policy: numeric storage and approved numeric/labelled classes only; factors, character, integer64 and unknown classes rejected before coercion

v9_valid.3: 3. Propio compartido (pagado) con otras viviendas del sitio
v9_valid.4: 4. Propio compartido (pagándose) con otras viviendas del sitio

ci.method: with-replacement ultimate-cluster Taylor ratio; complete household design including outside-domain PSU
ci.singleton_policy: any singleton => SE/CI null; no undocumented adjustment
ci.n_psu_definition: All distinct (varstrat,varunit) pairs in full household sample, even outside domain

r2.assumptions: p_v is hypothetical share of DWELLINGS in sites containing exactly two dwellings; all other sites contain one dwelling; R1=roles/dwellings, R2=roles/sites.
